name: gen_3x5_ragged
note: generated: 3 jobs on 5 machines (more machines than jobs), jobs of 5, 3 and 4 tasks in that order; per job, machines = rng.sample(range(5), tasks) and then for each task a duration rng.randint(1, 9), Python random seed 2. Optimum 32 exceeds the longest job (27), so machine conflicts matter

name: gen_6x3
note: generated: 6 jobs on 3 machines (more jobs than machines), per job machines = rng.sample(range(3), 3) and then for each task a duration rng.randint(1, 9), Python random seed 1. Optimum 35 exceeds the busiest machine's load (34), so precedences matter
